Pricing built in (Option C) — what to check

• New section between the report and the closing CTA; “Pricing” / “Precios” in the header and footer nav.
• Flash: USD 500, under 5 days, up to 7 findings with fixes, unauthenticated, no retest, credited in full toward a full pentest within 90 days.
• Tiers: Essential USD 2,900 · Standard USD 5,900 · Advanced from USD 9,500 — scope, user roles, testing days, retest window; attestation letter with every full pentest. API endpoint caps are left off the page.
• Continuous plans as agreed today: USD 450/mo (annual Essential, re-assessment at month 6, external check between assessments, unlimited retests, letter always current) and USD 990/mo (annual Standard, re-assessment at month 6, testing after major changes, quarterly external check, unlimited retests, priority scheduling, letter always current). Advanced custom. Retests cover reported findings.
• Decide the “fewer than 7 findings” answer for the Flash and what moves the Advanced “from”; each is one short line when you have it.
• Spanish uses “retest” as on your pricing page; the sample finding card still says “retesteo pendiente”.

Pricing options — Option C was chosen on 2 Sep 2026 and built into the landing boards on the Landing page, with the Continuous plans expanded to their agreed contents. A and B are kept here for reference only.
